title: A newcomer's life: lean berries and a house with signs
about: As `life`, with berry bushes at 40% of the island's density (the seed's resource_scale). Before the newcomer's mind starts, a Brackenford resident is given writing, fishing and smoking and three wood, walks into the unowned house nearest the arrival point, puts up two signs there (the ordinary write skill: signs are structures that hold their text and topic), and goes home. Reading a sign needs writing, which no newcomer has; experimenting with wood can reveal it.
gradient: Forage in a lean land -> explore -> find the empty house and its signs -> learn writing (experiment with wood) -> read the signs: fishing, smoking -> fish, smoke fish over a fire (fire is known) -> food that keeps through winter; the empty house is also a shelter.

do.text: This house kept nets on the river. A net set at the bend took fish every morning.
Fish hung over smoke for a day keep through the winter.
